2608.23566.title: How to Train a Critic Stably and Efficiently
2608.23566.paper_summary: Group-based reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO for large language models avoid training a critic by sampling multiple responses for each prompt. A reliable critic could instead estimate token-level advantages from one response, but standard critic-based training recipes are often unstable. We study this instability and develop \textbf{Best-Practice Critic Optimization (BPCO)}, a recipe that combines DPPO, value predictions bounded to the reward range, Monte Carlo value targets, unnormalized policy advantages, and length-adaptive generalized advantage estimation. Because the critic is used only during training, BPCO can also condition it on reward-defining information, such as a reference answer or grading rubric, that is hidden from the policy. Controlled experiments isolate the effect of each design choice. Across mathematical reasoning tasks with models ranging from 1.5B parameters to 30B-A3B mixtures of experts, BPCO improves a strong critic-based baseline consistently, and matches or exceeds a group-based baseline while sampling one response per prompt. The same recipe also improves learning with rubric-based rewards. These results show that a carefully designed critic provides a reliable alternative to group-relative advantage estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/QPHutu/golden_critic
2608.23566.paper_summary_zh: 基於群體的強化學習方法，如 GRPO，對於大型語言模型而言，通過為每個提示採樣多個回應來避免訓練評估器。可靠的評估器可以從一個回應中估計令牌級別的優勢，但標準的基於評估器的訓練方法往往不穩定。我們研究了這種不穩定性，並開發了 \textbf{最佳實踐評估器優化 (BPCO)}，這是一種結合了 DPPO、被限制在獎勵範圍內的價值預測、蒙特卡羅價值目標、未標準化的策略優勢和長度自適應的廣義優勢估計的配方。由於評估器僅在訓練期間使用，BPCO 還可以根據獎勵定義信息進行調整，例如參考答案或評分標準，這些信息對策略是隱藏的。控制實驗隔離了每個設計選擇的影響。在數學推理任務中，模型範圍從 1.5B 參數到 30B-A3B 專家混合，BPCO 一直穩定地改善了一個強大的基於評估器的基線，並在每個提示中採樣一個回應時達到或超過基於群體的基線。相同的配方也改善了基於評分標準的獎勵學習。這些結果顯示，精心設計的評估器提供了一個可靠的替代方案，以進行群體相對優勢估計。代碼可在 https://github.com/QPHutu/golden_critic 獲得。
